P2.description: 2 frames, total_len = 2^20 + 10; plaintext byte i = (7*i+3) mod 256; sequence 8; counter reused value 1 with sequence 8
P2.note: ikm uses sequence 8 and counter 1; regenerate with gen_vectors.py

_note: REVIEW_REFERENCE_ONLY. Public deterministic TEST-ONLY keys. Expected values derived from RSE12_04 text.

negatives.name: N01 header sequence bit flipped, not re-signed
N02 ciphertext bit flipped, not re-signed
N03 signature bit flipped
N04 sequence changed AND re-signed by sender key (AAD/info mismatch)
negatives.spec_basis: s4 AAD=header, info binds sequence; s6 Phase2

negatives.name: N05 type changed 1->2 AND re-signed (info binds type)
N06 frame addressed to a different recipient_id
N07 right recipient_id but encrypted to a different KEM key
negatives.spec_basis: s2/s6 recipient key binding via HPKE

negatives.name: N08 sender substitution: attacker key signs, claims enrolled sender_id
N09 sender_id not enrolled (valid signature by its own key)
N10 enc top bit set (non-canonical), re-signed
N11 enc all-zero, re-signed
N12 enc = low-order point u=1 (canonical), re-signed: zero DH output must abort
N13 truncated frame
N14 trailing byte
N15a version 1
N15b version 3
N15c version 0
N16 bad magic
N17 stale incident epoch (grant says epoch 3)
N18 sequence outside the V grant range
N19 wrong artifact for the grant
N20 sender differs from the grant's sender
N22 Ed25519 signature malleated with S+L (non-canonical S)
negatives.spec_basis: RSE12_04 open point: strict Ed25519 verification (reject non-canonical S)

negatives.name: N21 header bundle_digest does not match decrypted plaintext (sender lies)
N30 missing middle frame
N31 duplicated frame
N32 reordered frames
N33 extra frame beyond count
N34 truncated final frame
N35 cross-bundle frame injection (valid signature, different bundle)
N36 only the first frame of a multi-frame bundle

profile: HPKE RFC9180 base X25519/HKDF-SHA256/ChaCha20Poly1305 + Ed25519; OCR1 v2 (RSE12_04)
stateful_cases_not_expressible_as_vector: S01 replay: accepting the same bundle (same sequence) a second time MUST be refused by recipient state (RSE12_04 s7 replay).
S02 duplicate enc under a different bundle_digest MUST be flagged and the sender quarantined (RSE12_04 s7).
S03 sequence numbers consumed by an interrupted ACTIVE grant MUST NOT be reused (RSE12_02 s7).
S04 key-absent Phase 1 MUST leave the secret volume locked (RSE12_04 s6; acceptance C22).
